blocks.text: 1 Chronicles 4 contains 43 verses. It opens with: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal. It concludes with: And they smote the remnant of the Amalekites that escaped, and have dwelt there unto this day. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: The genealogies are selective literary maps of kinship, land, office, and restored identity rather than exhaustive modern biological pedigrees; gaps, parallel lines, variant names, and telescoping require case-by-case review.
